dct_title_s: The lots which are distinguished on this map by green have been allotted by the subscribers, in the division of the property of the minister, elders, and deacons of the Reformed Protestant Dutch Church in the city of Albany, to ballot no. 1 and those distinguished by yellow to ballot no. 2, November 8th, 1815
